headline: **MLB Daily Recap: Guardians, Pirates, and Braves Take Wins**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense and Joey Cantillo dominating on the mound. The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the St. Louis Cardinals 6-2, with Braxton Ashcraft earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Brandon Lowe led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Burch Smith, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers due to right shoulder inflammation. The Cincinnati Reds have also placed Ke'Bryan Hayes on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 21, 2026, due to a lumbar bulging disc. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the Los Angeles Angels, Chicago Cubs, St. Louis Cardinals, Colorado Rockies, and Atlanta Braves.

The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn. The Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash. The Athletics traded CF Junior Perez to the Chicago White Sox for LHP Jackson Nove.

top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Braxton Ashcraft earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 1 earned run. Brandon Lowe led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals with a final score of 2-1, securing a crucial win. David Peterson earned the win for the Mets, while Devin Williams secured the save.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Marlins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the charge at the plate. Harris II hit two home runs, including his 11th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Cubs 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs in their latest matchup. Christian Vázquez and Pete Crow-Armstrong were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Reds Shut Down Cardinals in Thrilling 0-0 Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a hard-fought victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, winning the game 0-0. The Reds' Zach McCambley played a key role in the team's win.

top_news.title: **Tigers RHP Burch Smith Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Burch Smith has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins on May 21, 2026, in exchange for RHP Zach McCambley.
